disposition_reason: The raw data is delivered as three separate capture sessions. The only label-blind ordering of those sessions is wall-clock, and wall-clock places the entire anomaly-bearing capture (2017-05-14) strictly before both normal captures (2017-05-16/17). A label-blind chronological burn-in then consumes every anomaly and leaves an evaluation window with no positives. Ordering the sessions any other way would use the source-provided normal/abnormal file identity, which is ground truth. The architecture is therefore an ACTIVE source domain and is not a LOAO target fold.
